title: Ting Ching Li

page_data.en:
420
2/7/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

30th June 1916.

Sir,
At 6.30 p.m. 29th instant a bomb explosion occurred
at No. 30 Ting Ching Li 長慶里 alleyway, Avenue
Joffre, killing one man and wounding three. It is
reported that the deceased and wounded men were rebels
and that they were engaged in making bombs when the
explosion took place.

There was a rumour in the City last night that
General Yang had been murdered, but it is not true.
It is thought that some of the detectives who will
soon be dismissed started the report.

It is reported that Premier Tuan Chi Jui has sent
a high officer named Chung Ts Bang 龔志鵬 to Shanghai
to try to persuade the navy to cancel its independence.

It is reported that the situation is critical at
Woosung, and that the ships may start to bombard the
forts in the near future.

Your obedient servant,

[签名]

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

[手写批注]

1916年7月2日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年6月30日。

先生：

本月29日下午6时30分，霞飞路长庆里30号弄堂内发生炸弹爆炸事件，造成一人死亡，三人受伤。据报，死者及伤者均为反叛分子，爆炸发生时他们正在制造炸弹。

昨晚市内流传杨将军被谋杀的谣言，但此消息不实。据信，该谣言系由几名即将被解职的侦探所散布。

据报，国务总理段祺瑞已派遣一名名为龚志鹏的高级官员前往上海，试图劝说海军取消独立。

据报，吴淞局势危急，舰只可能在近期开始炮击炮台。

您的顺从仆人，

[签名]

总探长。

警务处总监。

[手写批注]
